fragments.text: Could we add nontopology loop info to the tailing log as well?

reply_text:
The solve loop already logs one line per event to the journal, in the same format as the topology logs. I'll feed that into the tail too:It works. Committing, then restarting the Emacs buffer so it runs the new version:`*topology-tail*` now shows the solve loop alongside the two topology loops. I restarted it, so it has replayed the last two hours (605ed7b2).

- **`solve → solve-2 m99A01`** means a seat has taken a problem.
- **`solve ✗ solve-2 m98A06 attempt 4 refused: …`** is a refused attempt, with the reason.
- **`★ m98A03 CLOSED`** now appears for every closed problem, not just topology ones. Solve-loop closures show up there once, rather than also as a separate line.

The solve loop has closed three more problems since the restart: m97A04 (01:21), m97A02 (01:24) and m98A03 (01:39).

The most common refusal is "proposal still contains sorry". Those partial proofs aren't lost, since the next attempt continues from them. But some problems use up all 4 attempts that way; m98A06 is one. If that keeps happening, the loop should stop after four attempts that don't reduce the `sorry` count, rather than after four attempts in total. That would be the same rule as the topology loops' stop-after-two.
